description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for several editing methods applied to a large language model on the BioMedLM dataset, with “Base” representing the model without editing. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 1, 10<sup>1</sup>, and 10<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels at 0, 40, 50, 55, and 60, and 65. The “Base” line is black, uses circle markers, is solid, and starts at approximately 39% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “MEND” line is brown, uses diamond markers, is solid, and starts at approximately 43% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 56% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “FT” line is blue, uses triangle markers, is solid, and starts at approximately 41% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 44% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The “MEMIT” line is purple, uses square markers, is solid, and starts at approximately 51% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 53% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.  The “ROME” line is green, uses square markers, is solid, and begins at approximately 50% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 62% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. The "IKE" line is red, uses triangle markers, is solid, and begins at approximately 43% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and ends at approximately 53.5% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
